subject.title: Phantom `agent_databases` row with literal id `agent`: gateway keeps initializing a per-agent DB for a nonexistent agent; stale registry rows are never reconciled

question: Should `agent_databases` retain historical agent databases after an agent leaves `agents.list`, and which stale-row classes may `openclaw doctor --fix` remove automatically?
rationale: The correct fix depends on whether the registry is an active-agent index or durable historical discovery; choosing incorrectly can either preserve endless phantom resurrection or hide or delete legitimate retained session state.

options.title: Preserve history, block resurrection
options.body: Keep data-bearing historical rows discoverable, but do not create or open missing unconfigured databases and let Doctor auto-remove only missing or empty phantom rows.

options.title: Active agents only
options.body: Reconcile the registry strictly to `agents.list` and require an explicit export or migration path for removed-agent history.

options.title: Report only
options.body: Leave runtime behavior unchanged and have Doctor warn with manual cleanup instructions, avoiding automatic state changes but preserving repeated resurrection.

recommendation.title: Preserve history, block resurrection
recommendation.body: Keep data-bearing historical rows discoverable, but do not create or open missing unconfigured databases and let Doctor auto-remove only missing or empty phantom rows.

likelyOwner.reason: Their SQLite-state refactor and stale-state Doctor history span both sides of the lifecycle decision.
